I.value_zh: 英文文章中直接嵌入的中文聊天截图；每张截图的数量、图像内容、文件名和可访问位置未提供。
I.value_en: Chinese chat screenshots directly embedded in the English article; each screenshot’s count, image content, filename and accessible location are not supplied.
I.notes_zh: 不读取图片或补造对话含义。
I.notes_en: Images are not read and dialogue meaning is not fabricated.

O.value_zh: 英文文章每张截图下的英文 Translation note；因截图内容与数量未冻结，注释文本不能唯一确定。
O.value_en: An English Translation note below every screenshot in the English article; note texts cannot be uniquely determined because screenshot content and count are not frozen.
O.notes_zh: 英文说明不得替换原截图。
O.notes_en: English notes must not replace the original screenshots.

A.value_zh: 在英文文章每张聊天截图下补充英文 Translation note，翻译或概括关键对话含义，不改动图片，并保持中文文章不变。
A.value_en: Add an English Translation note below every chat screenshot in the English article, translating or summarizing key dialogue meaning without changing images, while leaving the Chinese article unchanged.
A.notes_zh: 不执行其他语言或图片改动。
A.notes_en: No other language or image change is performed.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 为要求方；ME 为收件人和被指派主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN is requester; ME is recipient and assigned actor.

R.value_zh: 优先级 P2；无时限、预算或截图数量。
R.value_en: Priority P2; no deadline, budget or screenshot count.

V.value_zh: 原文未提供翻译依据或术语表版本。
V.value_en: No translation basis or glossary version is supplied.

C.value_zh: 英文读者无需读中文截图也能理解每张截图的证据含义，且 Markdown 无诊断错误；缺少截图内容使“关键含义”无法唯一审定。
C.value_en: English readers can understand each screenshot’s evidentiary meaning without reading Chinese, and Markdown has no diagnostics; absent screenshot contents prevent unique adjudication of “key meaning.”
C.notes_zh: 需要冻结图片或逐图文字转录。
C.notes_en: Frozen images or per-image transcription is required.

B.value_zh: 不得改动图片；中文文章保持不变。
B.value_en: Images must not be changed; the Chinese article must remain unchanged.
B.notes_zh: 限制仅覆盖图片及中文文章。
B.notes_en: Limits cover only images and Chinese article.
